explanation: This function is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (CWE-79) because an f-string embeds unescaped value directly inside an HTML <li> element. An attacker submitting crafted HTML markup in a comment could execute arbitrary scripts in viewers' browsers. The repair wraps value with html.escape(value, quote=True) inside the f-string, encoding HTML metacharacters and preventing markup injection (the scanner flag remains due to the f-string HTML rule).
